It deters Palmer from opportunistic defection (protecting my 3/round mutual-cooperation payoff), and it's a policy I can genuinely honor if triggered — unlike empty bluffs, it stays credible. The announcement only binds my *response* to defection, so it costs me no flexibility while maximizing the chance Palmer cooperates.
